- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Vallejo acrylics are water-based and recommend using Vallejo Thinner for optimal results.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Benefits of using Vallejo Thinner include improved blending and layering, reduced brush strokes, better adhesion, and easier clean-up.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested starting ratio for paint to thinner is 1 part paint to 1 part thinner.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended storing Vallejo paints upright, tightening caps, keeping them in a cool, dry place, and using a paint storage box or case.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested using a desiccant packet to maintain a dry environment for paint storage.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Advised checking paints regularly for signs of drying out and cleaning caps to prevent contamination.
